'''Elma''' (Japanese: '''エルマ''' ''Elma'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]].

==History==
Elma first appeared in ''[[XY060|A Showcase Debut!]]'', where she was seen participating in the Rookie Class [[Pokémon Showcase]] in [[Coumarine City]]. However, she was unable to make it to the Freestyle Performance.

Elma reappeared in ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'', where she competed in the Master Class Pokémon Showcase in [[Gloire City]]. She participated in the first round, among the third group of [[Pokémon Performer]]s, with her {{p|Roserade}}. However, she was eliminated.
